# `description-when-to-use`

**Tool rule** · `info` · **off by default**, enable it to use it

Descriptions say when to call the tool, not only what it does, so a model can choose between it and its neighbours.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "description-when-to-use": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "description-when-to-use": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule description-when-to-use=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/description-when-to-use": "error" } }
```
